title: Fold Carousel
description: A carousel that folds from one slide to the next like a two-panel hinge: the image stays flat while the frame folds around it, with blur and shade on the turning leaf.

loop.script: hover[1] → click[1] → wait → wait → click[1] → wait → wait

props.name: FoldCarousel slides
props.description: One slide per item; anything that fills a box works, like or next/image with fill.

props.name: FoldCarousel loop
props.description: Whether the last slide folds on to the first.

props.name: FoldCarousel duration
props.description: Seconds a turn takes to settle onto a slide (a spring with no bounce).

props.name: FoldCarousel defaultIndex / onIndexChange
props.description: The slide shown first; called with the slide a turn is heading for as soon as it starts.

props.name: FoldCarouselFrame variant
props.description: door swings the next slide in behind the current one; book lays it underneath, like a page.

props.name: FoldCarouselFrame panelWidth / depth / bezelColor
props.description: Width of one square panel (the frame is two wide); perspective distance in panel widths (above 1); the colour on a leaf's edge mid-turn and in place of an unloaded slide.

props.name: FoldCarouselPrevious / FoldCarouselNext
props.description: Fold back or on one slide; children replace the chevron. At an end without a loop they stay focusable and do nothing.

props.name: useFoldCarousel()
props.type: { index, count, canPrev, canNext, prev, next, goTo }
props.description: Reads the surrounding carousel, for your own dots or counter.

a11y: A region with aria-roledescription="carousel" (label it with aria-label); the frame is a group with aria-roledescription="slide" and an "n of m" label, and a polite live region announces the slide on change.
Screen readers and Tab reach one copy of each slide; the other copies a fold paints are inert.
Arrow keys change slides while focus is inside, also after clicking a slide; in right-to-left the keys follow the reading direction and the chevrons mirror.
Previous and next stay focusable at the ends when loop is off (aria-disabled), on every primitive.
Under prefers-reduced-motion slides cut instead of folding.
docs: Installed the fold carousel in `components/ui/` (nineteen files, all prefixed `fold-carousel`). Import from `@/components/ui/fold-carousel`: ``, where `photos` are elements that fill a box (``, or next/image with `fill`). Size it with `FoldCarouselFrame`'s `panelWidth` (the frame is two panels wide), and pick `variant="book"` for a page turn. Leave room around the frame: a leaf reaches past it mid-turn. Build your own controls with `useFoldCarousel()`. Ported from Kareem-AEz's fold carousel (MIT, copyright 2026 Kareem Ahmed); the license text is in each file.
